metadata.description: Claude Code mods from UTUVO: a loudness card for audio work, a guard that protects masters, a setup catalog, chimes, session colors and a running-sessions band. 中英雙語。

plugins.name: utuvo-loudness
plugins.description: when ffmpeg measures loudness (ebur128 or loudnorm), draws Integrated, True Peak and LRA under the tool row and checks them against Atmos Music, Apple Music, Spotify/YouTube and EBU R128 targets.

plugins.name: utuvo-guard
plugins.description: stops known agent mistakes before a Bash command runs (wrangler r2 without --remote, npm uninstall -g without --prefix, pkill -f rsync, self-matching pgrep waits, AppleScript content search in Mail) and protects original audio masters from being deleted, moved, overwritten or converted in place. Add `# guard-ok: <reason>` to override; everything is logged to ~/.local/log/utuvo-guard.log.

plugins.name: utuvo-catalog
plugins.description: /catalog opens a pane with the tokens each MCP server, skill, memory file and agent adds to the context, how often each was used and when last; anything unused for 14 days is marked. Read-only.

plugins.name: utuvo-chime
plugins.description: one soft chime when a turn of 20 s or longer finishes, a second one when Claude waits for your answer or a permission prompt opens. /chime off | on | test.

plugins.name: utuvo-session-colors
plugins.description: the color block at the start of a session title (16 kinds: 🟥🟧🟨🟩🟦🟪🟫⬛⬜🔳🟢🔷🔶🔹🏢🪐) sets a whole desktop theme and a night-sky backdrop; a 🔥 in the title adds a slowly breathing glow. Desktop app, dark mode.

plugins.name: utuvo-session-board
plugins.description: a band above the prompt listing the Claude Code sessions busy right now on this Mac and how long each has run; over 3 hours is flagged as possibly stuck. Updates every 5 s.
